description: Buildings standing in the SCNU 360 VR tour that no GIS건물통합정보 record covers. Footprints are traced by eye on the NGII 2025 orthophoto with the VR view as the reference; floors are counted on the VR facade. Every record is estimated (estimated: true) and its label is shown as an estimate. Merged after gis-buildings.json by stages/sources.mjs (loadVrBuildings); schema in README "VR-only buildings".
sources: SCNU 360 VR tour (visual reference only, nothing copied)
NGII 2025 orthophoto sheet 34702020 (footprints traced by eye, 0.25 m GSD)

buildings.name: 순천대학교 D5 학군단
buildings.label: 학군단
buildings.nameSource: SCNU registry D5 학군단 (campus list.do point 243578.6, 263932.9 EPSG:5186, 2.3 m from the traced centroid); VR scene_d5 sign D5 학군단 / 159 ROTC. A different building from the demolished 학군단 (B9) lot at (244098, 263974), GIS record 768588, which stays skipped

buildings.name: 순천대학교 A13 웅지관
buildings.label: 웅지관
buildings.nameSource: SCNU registry A13 웅지관 (campus list.do point 244016.5, 263531.7 EPSG:5186, inside the traced outline); VR scene_a13 sign A13 웅지관; scene_001 hotspots spot1/spot18 point at the same building. The un-outlined solar-roofed building at the stadium south-west corner (the other candidate, 243898 263562, is the 26동 lawn). uni.glb already draws this building as BLD_Dormitory_Building.004 with no name: the generator matches this record into that node (name, floors, look; the uni.glb outline and id stay), so no BLD_SCNU_A13 node is added
